translation: One of Gopaldasji's four disciples, Pandyaji, lived in Kandari. His tulsi-kyaro (raised tulsi-plant shrine) stands along the road leading to Kandari's railway station. This tulsi-kyaro had fallen into disrepair, and Premjivanbhai has had it repaired. The local people regard this tulsi-kyaro with reverence and consider it miraculous. Pandyaji's temple stands today in Kandari as the temple of Chaturbhuj. Revered Bhagvandas, in a time of hardship, had made his home in Kandari. Since Kahandasji, too, lived in Kandari, we shall, for these several reasons, embrace this Kandari as a sacred place of merit (punya sthali).
